title: Cache the F# owner-coverage partition per context selection
outcome: Truncated F# files compute retained-owner coverage once per selection instead of rebuilding the retained-context key set for each exposed count.
acceptance: Cold-build and delta owner-coverage parity tests remain green without changing any context limit
